interpreted_intent: Repair the preserved dawn home-studio synth-loop photograph within its closed local scope. The creative choice is a privately satisfying listening moment. A side view could emphasize the portrait but compress the hands and conceal cable endpoints; the selected raised frontal arrangement keeps actor-relative left/right distinct, with separate tabletop routes and enough empty border to inspect every endpoint. Sensual 1 appears through quiet presence and absorbed expression; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment. Creativity 1 supports local rearrangement and camera/light refinements. The one synthesizer, interface, laptop and speaker remain the same coherent music-making setup.

visual_priorities: The reference-guided face and focused listening presence

baseline_prompt_en: A photographic music-making scene in a quiet home studio at first blue dawn. The person guided by the supplied reference portrait is actively creating music, testing the final held chord of a synth loop while listening closely to its changing tone. Her visible facial features follow the supplied portrait, with its short dark bob with fine parted fringe. Her face is fully visible above the equipment; a slight absorbed smile and relaxed open overshirt give the concentrated moment a quiet, intimate appeal. She sits behind one compact synthesizer at a shallow rectangular desk, facing the camera. The entire desk perimeter and all equipment sit comfortably inside a wide landscape frame, with a clear band of tabletop beyond every cable bend. Her shoulders, elbows and wrists form two separate uncrossed arm chains. Her anatomical LEFT arm is on the RIGHT side of the photograph: that left index and middle finger press two adjacent white keys down. Her anatomical RIGHT arm is on the LEFT side of the photograph: that right thumb and index finger pinch and rotate one raised cutoff knob in the synthesizer's right-hand control bank. The keys and knob contact surfaces are seen from above; other fingers curve freely beside their targets. The synthesizer has its keyboard nearest the performer and its right control bank at image left, within easy reach of her right elbow. One audio interface sits in the open front-left corner of the desk and one laptop sits in the open front-right corner, its screen tilted toward the performer while its display remains visible to the camera. One nearfield speaker stands behind the laptop. A single black audio cable runs from a visible output jack on the synthesizer's camera-facing edge across exposed tabletop to a visible input jack on the audio interface; both inserted plugs and the full uninterrupted black route are visible. A separate blue USB cable runs from a visible USB socket on the audio interface in a broad shallow curve across the front center of the desk to a visible USB socket on the laptop's left edge; both inserted plugs and the full uninterrupted blue route are visible. The black and blue routes are spatially separate and fully contained inside the tabletop. On the laptop, a DAW arrangement shows a short repeated synth waveform region and its active track meter, visually belonging to this connected instrument setup. The speaker, laptop, interface and synthesizer each have their own clear outline. Photograph from a centered frontal viewpoint raised enough to look down over the entire tabletop, using a moderately wide natural perspective. Keep her face, the two distinct hand contacts, every cable segment and all four cable endpoints simultaneously sharp and large enough to inspect. Cool dawn light from the side window meets a low warm task light across her hands and the desk, preserving clean separation between dark cables, ports and pale wood. The feeling is a private breakthrough heard before the rest of the home wakes.
